select ap.id, ap.name, alert_id, ai.name as alertName, task_id, ci.task_name as taskName, conditions, ap.status, ap.create_time, ap.update_time from alert_policy ap left join alert_info ai on ap.alert_id = ai.id left join task_info ci on ap.task_id = ci.id

and ap.name like CONCAT('%', #{params.name}, '%')
and ai.name like CONCAT('%', #{params.alertName}, '%')
and ci.task_name like CONCAT('%', #{params.taskName}, '%')
and ap.status = #{params.status}
